note: Pinned expected and forbidden criteria. A criterion may be added, or decomposed into finer criteria when the decomposition is declared below, but it may never be silently removed or reworded away. This baseline is forward-looking: it constrains changes made after it was seeded, and makes no claim about the history before that point.
